ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The circuit shows two 10 kΩ resistors R1 and R2 forming a divider from VDD = +12 V to ground. The midpoint of the divider drives the gate of the upper MOSFET, which is a pMOS connected to the +12 V rail. The bottom of the divider is grounded and drives the gate of the lower MOSFET, which is an nMOS connected to VSS = -5 V. The two MOSFETs are in series, and ID is marked flowing downward. Reasoning: Because R1 = R2 = 10 kΩ, the upper pMOS gate voltage is 6 V. Its source is at +12 V, so VSG = 12 - 6 = 6 V. With |Vt| = 2 V, the pMOS overdrive is VSG - |Vt| = 4 V, giving a possible saturation current of K(4)^2 = 0.1 × 16 = 1.6 mA. For the lower nMOS, the gate is at 0 V and the source is at -5 V, so VGS = 0 - (-5) = 5 V. Its overdrive is VGS - Vt = 5 - 2 = 3 V, giving saturation current K(3)^2 = 0.1 × 9 = 0.9 mA. Since the MOSFETs are in series, the smaller available saturation current controls the branch current. The pMOS can support this lower current in its allowed/linear region, and the nMOS remains saturated. Therefore ID = 0.9 mA.

method.method_draft: First describe the image-derived circuit: the upper gate voltage is set by the 10 kΩ/10 kΩ divider, so VGp = 6 V; the lower gate is grounded, VGn = 0 V; the pMOS source is at +12 V and the nMOS source is at -5 V. Let the common node between the two MOSFETs be VX. From the text, |Vt| = 2 V and K = 0.1 mA/V². The lower nMOS has VGS = 5 V and overdrive 3 V. Assume it is saturated, giving ID = K(3)^2 = 0.9 mA, with condition VDS,n = VX + 5 ≥ 3, or VX ≥ -2 V. Now force the same 0.9 mA through the upper pMOS. It has VSG = 6 V and overdrive 4 V; if it is in triode, VSD,p = 12 - VX must satisfy 0.9 = 0.1[2(4)VSD - VSD²]. The physically valid triode root is VSD ≈ 1.35 V, so VX ≈ 10.65 V. This satisfies pMOS triode condition VSD < 4 V and nMOS saturation condition VX ≥ -2 V. Hence the consistent current is ID = 0.9 mA.
method.CoT_raw: 图像描述：图中上方电源标为 VDD = +12 V，左侧有两个串联电阻 R1 = 10 kΩ 和 R2 = 10 kΩ 从 +12 V 接到地；R1 与 R2 的中点连接到上方 MOSFET 的栅极。下方 R2 的底端接地，并且该地节点连接到下方 MOSFET 的栅极。右侧有上下两个 MOSFET 串联，上方为 pMOS，源极接 +12 V；下方为 nMOS，源极接 VSS = -5 V；两管中间相连形成公共节点，电流 ID 向下流过串联支路。推理：10 kΩ/10 kΩ 分压使上方 pMOS 栅压 VGp = 12 × 10/(10+10) = 6 V；下方 nMOS 栅压 VGn = 0 V。nMOS 源极为 -5 V，因此 VGS,n = 0 - (-5) = 5 V，过驱动电压 VOV,n = VGS,n - Vt = 5 - 2 = 3 V。先假设 nMOS 饱和，则 ID = K(VOV,n)^2 = 0.1 × 3^2 = 0.9 mA；饱和条件为 VDS,n ≥ VOV,n，即 VX - (-5) ≥ 3，所以 VX ≥ -2 V。对上方 pMOS，同一电流为 0.9 mA；其源极为 12 V、栅极为 6 V，所以 VSG,p = 12 - 6 = 6 V，过驱动 VOV,p = 6 - 2 = 4 V。若 pMOS 在线性区，设 VSD,p = 12 - VX，则 0.9 = 0.1[2(4)VSD - VSD^2]，即 9 = 8VSD - VSD^2，解得 VSD = 1.354 V 或 6.646 V。线性区要求 VSD < 4 V，故取 VSD ≈ 1.35 V，因此 VX ≈ 12 - 1.35 = 10.65 V。该 VX 满足 pMOS 线性区条件 VSD < 4 V，也满足 nMOS 饱和条件 VX ≥ -2 V，所以假设一致。故 ID = 0.9 mA。
